{{Quote|Hey, Wembly, you're a guard. Doesn't that mean you're supposed to guard us."<br />"That's a good one, kid, make sure to write it down. In case you didn't notice, preventing you scofflaws from offing each other isn't exactly in our job description.|[[Trig Longo]] and Wembly|<ref name="DT" />}}
'''Wembly''' was an [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] in his late fifties stationed on the [[Imperial prison barge]], [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. There, he met [[Armo Drane]], who asked the guard to deliver a letter to his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Tso Sook Drane]], and Wembly promised to do so. While on board the ''Purge'', a [[Wembly's BLX droid|droid]] had adopted Wembly as its master and followed him everywhere he went, an accompaniment that other officers on board the barge wouldn't have tolerated. After the ''Purge'' broke down, Wembly informed inmate brothers [[Kale Longo|Kale]] and [[Trig Longo]] that they had sent a crew to a nearby derelict [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. He also informed the brothers that [[Aur Myss]] had put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on them. He was infected by the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] virus, and though he died of it, his last action was to set the Longo brothers free. The letter was recovered aboard the ''Purge'' after its occupants were decimated by a plague, so it was unlikely that it reached him before it was released to the public for academic purposes in relation to the history of the ''Purge''.<ref name="DT" />
